turns.text: Bonjour, euh, hi. I have a flight from Dubai to Paris and I want to change it, alors, to an earlier one.
Hello, this is Skyline Air. I can help with that. Can I have your booking code and last name, please?
Thank you, Ms. Dubois. I have your booking: Dubai to Paris, flight SK312 on Saturday at 19:15, Economy. Which earlier flight would you like?
Alors, I would like the morning. Le matin. Like, earlier in the day, maybe?
We have SK310 from Dubai to Paris at 09:00, which is a morning flight. Is that the one you want, or a different time in the morning?
Oh, yes, okay, SK310, that sounds good. Is it, euh, is it expensive to change?
Your booking was made more than 24 hours ago and it is Economy, so there is a $75 change fee. You also pay any fare difference, and I can't confirm that exact difference from here.
Seventy-five dollars? Mais, that is a lot. Can I do it without the fee?
I'm sorry, the fee applies to Economy changes after the first 24 hours, and I can't waive it. Would you like to go ahead, or keep your current flight?
Hmm, alors. Can you tell me if the 9 o'clock has seats on Saturday?
I can see SK310 at 09:00 in our inventory, but I can't confirm seats on the Saturday date from here. I shouldn't change anything until seats are confirmed. Do you want to keep SK312 for now?
Okay, merci. I think I keep the 19:15 for now. Au revoir, bonne journée.
Your booking stays as it is, SK312 on Saturday at 19:15. Summary: no changes made, and we did not confirm a move to SK310. Have a good day.
